'''Jonathan C. Rougier''' is professor of [[statistical science]] at the [[University of Bristol]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bristol.ac.uk/maths/people/jonathan-c-rougier/index.html|title=Professor Jonathan Rougier - Maths|website=Bristol.ac.uk|accessdate=1 December 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://research-information.bristol.ac.uk/en/persons/jonathan-rougier(0b8c04c7-aeb7-483d-8d55-31a32a1df1d6).html|title=Professor Jonathan Rougier - University of Bristol|website=Research-information.bristol.ac.uk|accessdate=1 December 2017}}</ref> Rougier is a specialist in the assessment of the risk from natural hazards.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/volcano-super-eruption-apocalypse-wipe-out-life-human-kind-timeline-how-long-a8082006.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220614/https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/volcano-super-eruption-apocalypse-wipe-out-life-human-kind-timeline-how-long-a8082006.html |archive-date=14 June 2022 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live|title=Scientists predict a volcanic eruption that would destroy humanity could happen sooner than previously thought|date=29 November 2017|website=Independent.co.uk|accessdate=1 December 2017}}</ref>

He was an undergraduate at [[University College, Durham]].<ref>{{cite journal |title=Letters |journal=[[Palatinate (newspaper)|Palatinate]] |date=22 October 1987 |issue=416 |page=13 |url=https://iiif.durham.ac.uk/index.html?manifest=t2mvt150j34b&canvas=t2t05741v08s |accessdate=24 May 2019}}</ref> He completed a doctorate at [[Durham University]] in 1996, the thesis being titled ''Price change and volume in a speculative market''.<ref>{{cite thesis|last1=Rougier|first1=Jonathan|title=Price change and trading volume in a speculative market|url=https://etheses.dur.ac.uk/5347/|website=etheses.dur.ac.uk|accessdate=7 May 2018|date=1996|type=Doctoral }}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*J.C. Rougier, R.S.J. Sparks, and L.J. Hill (eds). ''Risk and Uncertainty Assessment for Natural Hazards''. [[Cambridge University Press]], Cambridge, 2013.
